current_prompt.body:
CALCULATE the ratio p/n
WHERE a class of p students has an average score of 70
AND a class of n students has an average score of 92
AND the combined average of both classes is 86
OUTPUT the ratio p/n

current_plan.body:
READ the given average scores for class p (70), class n (92), and the combined average (86)
FORMULATE the weighted average equation: (p * 70 + n * 92) / (p + n) = 86
MULTIPLY both sides by (p + n) to obtain: 70p + 92n = 86p + 86n
REARRANGE the equation to isolate terms involving p and n
SIMPLIFY to derive an expression for the ratio p/n
COMPUTE the numeric value of the ratio p/n from the simplified expression
OUTPUT the ratio p/n
